The control panel has buttons, switches, and a digital display. The machine has rollers and mechanical arms.
Photo 1 shows an open electrical control box with relays, contactors, and wiring. The box is green and appears to be part of the machine.
Photo 2 shows the machine from a different angle, with a motor and belt drive visible at the bottom. The control panel is open, revealing internal circuitry.
The machine appears to be a fabric or material processing machine, possibly for printing or laminating, given the rollers and control system.
The brand 'SEADMAN' is visible on the control panel in photo 0 and as a watermark in all photos.
The machine is outdoors on a dirt ground, with a metal fence and building in the background.
